newsitem.title: USA: Richfood to buy produce distributor.
newsitem.headline: Richfood to buy produce distributor.

text.p: Richfood Holdings Inc said it has tentatively agreed to acquire Norristown Wholesale Inc for undisclosed terms.

Norristown, a wholesale distributor of produce and other perishable food items, had 1995 revenues of about $120 million. It is headquartered near Philadelphia and supplies a full range of fresh produce, fruits and vegetables to over 400 retail supermarkets in Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey and Virginia.

When completed, the transaction will permit Richfood's Pennsylvania Division to add a complete range of fresh produce and perishable items, not currently offered by the division, to its current assortment of dry grocery, frozen food, cheese and dairy products, the company said.
Richfood anticipates that Norristown will continue to operate from its existing facilities, and that Richfood will offer employment to all of Norristown's current employees.
Completion of the transaction is subject to execution of a definitive purchase agreement, Richfood said.
